W1901: Building F ANK. Turkey now has 4 units. Focus on holding BLA/AEG and expanding to RUM/SER later if possible. Russia and Austria are strong neighbors; maintaining peace is priority.
S1902: Expanding to 8 centers. F ANK->BLA, F ARM->SEV, A BUL->CON, A SYR->ARM. Russia holds SEV/UKR. Austria has A SER. Goal: 8 centers (ANK, BUL, CON, SMY, ARM, BLA, SEV, SYR). Strong position.
F1902: Expanding. F BLA->RUM (bounces), A CON->BUL, A SYR->ARM, F ARM->SEV (bounces). Russia holds SEV. Austria has A RUM. Goal: 6 centers (ANK, BUL, CON, SMY, ARM, BLA). Strong position.
W1902: Building F ANK. Turkey now has 5 units. Focus on holding BLA/AEG and expanding to RUM/SER later if possible. Russia and Austria are strong neighbors; maintaining peace is priority.
